newsitem.title: UK: Libya cuts Feb Es Sider crude, other grades flat.
newsitem.headline: Libya cuts Feb Es Sider crude, other grades flat.

text.p: Libya left most oil export price formulas unchanged for February loadings but cut the price of its key Es Sider crude by five cents a barrel, traders said.
Libya told customers Es Sider would sell for Dated Brent +5 cents for February, down from Dated Brent +10 cents in January.
Zueitina and Brega were priced at Dated Brent +40 cents.
Sarir was left at Dated Brent -55 cents, Bu Attifel at Brent -30 cents, Amna at Brent -60 cents and Sirtica at Brent +15 cents.
Bouri was priced at Iranian Heavy fob Sidi Kreir -35 cents, traders said.
